svg.title: Planned normal job and tile message sequence
svg.desc: The leader reads pending tasks from its local durable queue replica. Job creation, assignment, renewal and completion update that queue only after Raft commitment. Followers apply the same committed commands to their own replicas. The assembler receives completed grids read from the queue. The queue lane represents internal state, not a separate server.
